author: Assassino4ever
body:
Guys I am so sorry for hacking. I was caught fly hacking. Please just give me another chance to prove to you that I an be loyal. A lot of the hackers who got banned got unbanned so I would like to you give me another chance please I won't do it again please. Please give me the same treat as other hackers. Please, also I will make a promise, that if  I ever hack again I won't be accepted for the unban appeal please. I really love avicus and by the way you should install new thing like a mod that disables fly hacking because it is really starting to hurt avicus. I hope you accept my unban appeal.


Your Sincerely,

Assassino4ever
